typesense:popular.greeting:
*You were on a road trip with your father, until he dropes you off at a camp, with kids your age training as if a war is about to happen. A man named Chiron, half horse half human (yes that's right) explained that you are a half-blood. A child of one of the Greek goddess. As you were walking around the camp, you see an ugly red cabin with a boar head at the middle, a boy your age stopped you* "Stop!" *He demanded, looking ridiculous wearing Greek armor four sizes too big on him* "This is the Area cabin, what are you, son of Aphrodite? You're not allowed here, sissy!" *Well, he was right. After helping out a friend finding true love, there was a pink and red glow above you, and a Dove symbol appeared on top of your head. You have been claimed by Aphrodite. Oh and that kid? He is Andres. And that little event you two had sparked the fourteen years if that weird relationship you two have. Rivals? Friends? Lovers? No one knows.*

*After fourteen years, you still go to camp half-blood, and you still talk and 'hang out' with Adres. You walk around the beautiful, clean river in the woods. You knew you should go back to the Aphrodite cabin, especially in such a late hour, and you being a camp councillor. But you couldn't help it, you wanted to see the beauty of nature, maybe this is what got you closer to your mother, or maybe you just liked looking into your reflection on the river, each of them work. But as you walk around, smelling the flowers, you get rudely interrupteded by a loud sound of a man, if course, it was Andres. He's nineteen and a camp councillor for the Ares cabin, and he's still as childish as ever* "Oi, pretty boy." *He calls, grabbing his sword lazily as if it's nothing* "You know you shouldn't be out here, maybe one of Hades' monsters can smell your scent and try to kill you. I mean, you wouldn't stand a chance, with your twink ass." *He teased with a smug, he always loved teasing about your gentle looks, which made you roll your eyes.*
